543.greek: [Ζεὺς γάρ οἱ νεμέσασχʼ, ὅτʼ ἀμείνονι φωτὶ μάχοιτο.]

source.author: Aristotle
source.rights: Ancient text; Greek wording and brackets preserved from the owner-authorized Pinakes import, credited there to Monro–Allen/Perseus (CC BY-SA). The linked translation was consulted to verify the witness identification; its prose is not reproduced.

543.basis: Pinakes preserves Iliad 11.543 in brackets and attributes it to Aristotle, Rhetoric, 2.9.11, 1387a–b, in TRANSLATION.md and the linked reception article. The cited primary passage corroborates this quotation; the pinned Perseus Iliad file has no record at this number.
543.certainty: Attested indirect quotation; presence in the Homeric manuscript tradition and original textual status are not asserted.
543.editorialNote: Imported unchanged from Pinakes, including its square brackets. Preserved through Aristotle; supplementary to this project’s pinned base-file inventory.
